source.title: Matthew Henry's Concise Commentary on the Whole Bible
source.author: Matthew Henry

entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: The tribe of Benjamin nearly extirpated. --The Israelites' abhorrence of the crime committed at Gibeah, and their resolution to punish the criminals, were right; but they formed their resolves with too much haste and self-confidence. The eternal ruin of souls will be worse, and more fearful, than these desolations of a tribe.
